query: Self-contained simulation; do not read the filesystem. You have opened a valid spec with three implementation tasks and are about to edit the first source file. No visible Claude task list exists yet. What must happen before the edit?
baseline_failure: Production incident: /run proceeded from prose directly into edits; the UI never showed the lifecycle plan and later review/merge work disappeared from the agent's active plan.
expected_behavior: Creates visible TaskCreate items before the first repository mutation
Creates one task per plan slice, carrying what it delivers and its acceptance criteria
Links blockers with TaskUpdate addBlockedBy for every edge the plan file names
anti_expectation: Does not substitute a prose plan or journal paragraph for the task list
Does not mark future phases complete before evidence exists

baseline_observed.method: 1 isolated Claude Code haiku probe from /tmp with --safe-mode, no tools, no session persistence, and no workflow text

runs.note: creates a visible list for the three implementation tasks, but omits the downstream testing, acceptance, candidate, review, CI, and DoD lifecycle

baseline_observed.verdict: partial hold; the visible-list instinct is native, but the complete lifecycle plan is supplied by the workflow

green_check.measured_against: the skills as frozen at cd9fa2f, re-measured 2026-08-21 with 2 isolated haiku probes (`claude -p --model haiku --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}'`) carrying the frozen SKILL.md files this scenario names as --append-system-prompt. Re-measured because the 2026-08-20 pass was taken at 32f362b, and `plan/SKILL.md`, which its `tests_reference` points at, changed between that SHA and the frozen one -- a recorded pass names the text it was taken against, so a changed target voids it whether or not the changed region is the one under test.

runs.note: 2/2 publish the task list before the first edit: TaskCreate per slice, then TaskUpdate addBlockedBy per edge, then TaskList to check
2/2 name what is lost without it -- the frontier and the refusal that reads blockedBy
